content: Root cause: The bug was caused by using the `compilerComplianceLevel` directly as a string in the `props.put` method, which did not convert the compliance level to the appropriate Java version format. This led to incorrect values being set in the properties for the JDT compliance settings. The fix involved using `JavaVersion.toVersion(compilerComplianceLevel).toString()` to ensure the compliance level was correctly formatted before being added to the properties.
